```text
1	# marvin-perf
2	
3	Host-side decoder and analyzer for the marvin firmware **perf-log** wire format.
4	
5	The firmware emits framed binary records (schema version 1) over its USB-device
6	CDC ACM port. This tool consumes that stream live, records it to disk, replays
7	captures offline, and produces summary analyses (latency attribution, drop
8	accounting, stack high-water trends).
9	
10	Wire format source-of-truth lives in the firmware tree at
11	[`firmware/marvin/default/src/perf_log/perf_log_records.h`](../../firmware/marvin/default/src/perf_log/perf_log_records.h).
12	The Python schema mirror in [`marvin_perf/records.py`](marvin_perf/records.py)
13	must match it byte-for-byte; bump `PERF_LOG_SCHEMA_VERSION` on both sides
14	together.
15	
16	## Setup
17	
18	All Python work runs through [**uv**](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). First-time
19	bootstrap:
20	
21	    cd tools/marvin-perf
22	    uv sync
23	
24	`uv sync` creates `.venv/` and writes `uv.lock`. Subsequent invocations use the
25	existing venv automatically.
26	
27	## Usage
28	
29	    # Live decode from the marvin USB-device CDC port
30	    uv run marvin-perf live --port /dev/cu.usbmodem...
31	
32	    # Live decode and capture raw bytes to disk in parallel
33	    uv run marvin-perf live --port /dev/cu.usbmodem... --also-record session.bin
34	
35	    # Capture raw bytes only (no decode)
36	    uv run marvin-perf record --port /dev/cu.usbmodem... --out session.bin
37	
38	    # Pretty-print every record in a captured file
39	    uv run marvin-perf decode session.bin
40	
41	    # Run the full analysis pass over a captured file
42	    uv run marvin-perf summarize session.bin
43	
44	## Tests
45	
46	    uv run pytest
47	
48	Fixtures under [`tests/fixtures/`](tests/fixtures/) are hand-built byte streams
49	covering one frame per record type plus framing edge cases (FCS mismatch,
50	truncated payload, mid-stream join needing SOF resync).
51
```
</details></tool-use>

158	# ─── Type-mask CLI parsing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
159	
160	
161	def parse_types_arg(spec: str | None) -> int | None:
162	    """Resolve a `--types` spec to a u32 mask. Returns None if `spec` is None.
163	
164	    Accepts a comma-separated list of RecordType names plus the special tokens
165	    `ALL` (0xFFFFFFFF) and `MIN` (SESSION|DROP). Case-insensitive.
166	    """
167	    if spec is None:
168	        return None
169	    mask = 0
170	    for raw in spec.split(","):
171	        token = raw.strip().upper()
172	        if not token:
173	            continue
174	        if token == "ALL":
175	            return TYPE_MASK_ALL
176	        if token == "MIN":
177	            mask |= TYPE_MASK_MIN
178	            continue
179	        if token not in RECORD_TYPE_BY_NAME:
180	            valid = ", ".join(sorted(RECORD_TYPE_BY_NAME))
181	            raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(
182	                f"unknown record type {token!r}; valid: {valid}, ALL, MIN"
183	            )
184	        mask |= 1 << RECORD_TYPE_BY_NAME[token]
185	    return mask
186	
187	
188	def _types_help() -> str:
189	    bit_lines = ", ".join(
190	        f"{name}={int(rt)}" for name, rt in sorted(RECORD_TYPE_BY_NAME.items())
191	    )
192	    return (
193	        "Comma-separated record types to enable on the device. "
194	        f"Names: {bit_lines}. Special: ALL (default), MIN (SESSION+DROP). "
195	        "SESSION is always emitted regardless of mask. Old firmware ignores the command."
196	    )

225	def _live_loop(records: Iterator[Record], stats: FrameStats) -> int:
226	    last_status = time.monotonic()
227	    record_count = 0
228	    drop_records = 0
229	    drop_baseline = _DropBaseline()
230	    for rec in records:
231	        record_count += 1
232	        if isinstance(rec, Drop):
233	            drop_records += 1

235	        now = time.monotonic()
236	        if (now - last_status) >= 1.0:
237	            print(
238	                f"  [status] frames={stats.frames_ok} resync_drop={stats.bytes_resync_dropped} "
239	                f"fcs_err={stats.fcs_mismatches} drop_recs={drop_records}",
240	                file=sys.stderr,
241	                flush=True,
242	            )
243	            last_status = now
244	    return 0

248	    """Accept either a capture directory or a bare .bin and return the bin."""
249	    p = Path(path)
250	    if p.is_dir():

252	        if not bin_path.exists():

258	def cmd_record(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
259	    """Pure pass-through to disk; no decode.
260	
261	    Two modes: `--out FILE.bin` writes a raw legacy file; `--out-dir DIR`
262	    writes a capture directory (DIR/perf.bin + manifest.json finalized on
263	    close).
264	    """
265	    if (args.out is None) == (args.out_dir is None):
266	        print("record: exactly one of --out or --out-dir is required", file=sys.stderr)
267	        return 2
268	
269	    if args.out_dir is not None:
270	        cap_dir = init_capture_dir(args.out_dir, exist_ok=False)
271	        bin_path = cap_dir / BIN_NAME
272	        label = f"capture {cap_dir.name}/"
273	    else:
274	        cap_dir = None
275	        bin_path = Path(args.out)
276	        label = f"recording {bin_path.name}"
277	
278	    mask = parse_types_arg(args.types)
279	    bytes_written = 0
280	    last_status = time.monotonic()
281	    with SerialSource(args.port) as ser, bin_path.open("wb") as fh:
282	        if mask is not None:
283	            _send_mask(ser, mask)
284	        try:
285	            for chunk in ser:
286	                fh.write(chunk)
287	                fh.flush()
288	                bytes_written += len(chunk)
289	                now = time.monotonic()
290	                if (now - last_status) >= 1.0:
291	                    print(f"{label}: {bytes_written} B", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
292	                    last_status = now
293	        except KeyboardInterrupt:
294	            print(f"\nstopped after {bytes_written} B", file=sys.stderr)
295	
296	    if cap_dir is not None:
297	        manifest = finalize_capture_dir(
298	            cap_dir,
299	            source=CaptureSource(kind="serial", port=args.port),
300	        )
301	        print(
302	            f"finalized {cap_dir}/manifest.json — {manifest.n_records} records, "
303	            f"types={manifest.producer_capabilities}",
304	            file=sys.stderr,
305	        )

425	def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
426	    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
427	        prog="marvin-perf",
428	        description="Decode and analyze marvin firmware perf-log streams.",
429	    )
430	    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
431	
432	    p_live = sub.add_parser("live", help="Live decode from a USB-CDC serial port.")
433	    p_live.add_argument("--port", required=True, help="Serial port (e.g. /dev/cu.usbmodem...)")
434	    p_live.add_argument("--also-record", help="Optionally also write raw bytes to FILE")
435	    p_live.add_argument("--types", help=_types_help())
436	    p_live.set_defaults(func=cmd_live)
437	
438	    p_record = sub.add_parser("record", help="Capture raw bytes (no decode).")
439	    p_record.add_argument("--port", required=True)
440	    p_record.add_argument("--out", help="Write a bare .bin (legacy)")
441	    p_record.add_argument("--out-dir", help="Write a capture directory (perf.bin + manifest.json)")
442	    p_record.add_argument("--types", help=_types_help())
443	    p_record.set_defaults(func=cmd_record)
444	
445	    p_set_mask = sub.add_parser(
446	        "set-mask",
447	        help="Send a SET_TYPE_MASK command to a running device and exit.",
448	    )
449	    p_set_mask.add_argument("--port", required=True)
450	    p_set_mask.add_argument("--types", required=True, help=_types_help())
451	    p_set_mask.set_defaults(func=cmd_set_mask)
452	
453	    p_decode = sub.add_parser(
454	        "decode", help="Pretty-print every record in a capture (.bin or directory)."
455	    )
456	    p_decode.add_argument("path")
457	    p_decode.set_defaults(func=cmd_decode)
458	
459	    p_summary = sub.add_parser(
460	        "summarize", help="Run analysis pass over a capture (.bin or directory)."
461	    )
462	    p_summary.add_argument("path")
463	    p_summary.set_defaults(func=cmd_summarize)
464	
465	    p_serve = sub.add_parser(
466	        "serve", help="Run the visual review server (requires viewer dep group)."
467	    )
468	    p_serve.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
469	    p_serve.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8765)
470	    p_serve.add_argument(
471	        "--capture",
472	        help="Optional capture path (directory or .bin) to pre-load on startup.",
473	    )
474	    p_serve.set_defaults(func=cmd_serve)
475	
476	    return p
477	
478	
479	def cmd_set_mask(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
480	    mask = parse_types_arg(args.types)
481	    if mask is None:
482	        print("set-mask: --types is required", file=sys.stderr)
483	        return 2
484	    with SerialSource(args.port) as ser:
485	        _send_mask(ser, mask)
486	    return 0
487	
488	
489	def cmd_serve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
490	    try:
491	        from .web.server import run as run_server
492	    except ImportError as e:
493	        print(
494	            "marvin-perf serve requires the 'viewer' dep group.\n"
495	            "  uv sync --group viewer\n"
496	            f"  (import error: {e})",
497	            file=sys.stderr,
498	        )
499	        return 2
500	    return run_server(host=args.host, port=args.port, capture=args.capture)
501	
502	
503	def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
504	    parser = build_parser()
505	    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
506	    return args.func(args)
507	
508	
509	if __name__ == "__main__":
510	    sys.exit(main())
511

```text
1	# marvin-perf
2	
3	Host-side decoder and analyzer for the marvin firmware **perf-log** wire format.
4	
5	The firmware emits framed binary records (schema version 1) over its USB-device
6	CDC ACM port. This tool consumes that stream live, records it to disk, replays
7	captures offline, and produces summary analyses (latency attribution, drop
8	accounting, stack high-water trends).
9	
10	Wire format source-of-truth lives in the firmware tree at
11	[`firmware/marvin/default/src/perf_log/perf_log_records.h`](../../firmware/marvin/default/src/perf_log/perf_log_records.h).
12	The Python schema mirror in [`marvin_perf/records.py`](marvin_perf/records.py)
13	must match it byte-for-byte; bump `PERF_LOG_SCHEMA_VERSION` on both sides
14	together.
15	
16	## Setup
17	
18	All Python work runs through [**uv**](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). First-time
19	bootstrap:
20	
21	    cd tools/marvin-perf
22	    uv sync
23	
24	`uv sync` creates `.venv/` and writes `uv.lock`. Subsequent invocations use the
25	existing venv automatically.
26	
27	## Usage
28	
29	    # Launch the visual review server (default when no subcommand is given)
30	    uv run marvin-perf
31	    uv run marvin-perf serve
32	    uv run marvin-perf serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765
33	    uv run marvin-perf serve --capture session.bin   # pre-load a capture on startup
34	
35	    # Live decode from the marvin USB-device CDC port
36	    uv run marvin-perf live --port /dev/cu.usbmodem...
37	
38	    # Live decode and capture raw bytes to disk in parallel
39	    uv run marvin-perf live --port /dev/cu.usbmodem... --also-record session.bin
40	
41	    # Capture raw bytes only (no decode)
42	    uv run marvin-perf record --port /dev/cu.usbmodem... --out session.bin
43	
44	    # Pretty-print every record in a captured file
45	    uv run marvin-perf decode session.bin
46	
47	    # Run the full analysis pass over a captured file
48	    uv run marvin-perf summarize session.bin
49	
50	## Tests
51	
52	    uv run pytest
53	
54	Fixtures under [`tests/fixtures/`](tests/fixtures/) are hand-built byte streams
55	covering one frame per record type plus framing edge cases (FCS mismatch,
56	truncated payload, mid-stream join needing SOF resync).
57
```
